I eat them whole, bones and all. The ones near the stream are the best. I can hear them from the meadow. I don't like mice. They are too small and squeak too much.

A vole. The ones that run along the lane, and the ones in the field. They are the ones that squeak and run. I catch them in the dark, when they are not looking. I hear them under the leaves, and I pounce. They are easy.

Voles. They are the most common and easiest to catch. I hear them in the undergrowth and drop from the branch above. Their squeaks are like a mouse in a trap. I catch them with my feet and eat them whole. They are good, but not as good as a shrew.

A vole. I catch them by the stream. They are small, fat, and fast. I fly low and strike. Sometimes I get a mouse too, if they are near the wood. They are skinnier and harder to catch. I prefer voles. They are plentiful and easy. I eat them whole, head and all. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.
A shrew. It is the most common. I find it by sound, and it is not big. The vole is the next, and I eat it too. I do not hunt at night, only at dusk and dawn.
Voles. They are the most common. I hear them under the meadow, and the scent of them is in the air. I drop from the branch and strike.

Voles. They are small, and I can hear them moving through the grass and under the leaves. I fly down and grab them with my talons. They are quick, but I am quicker. A shrew. They are small and fast, but I catch them. They are under the holly bushes, and I hear them at night. They squeak like a mouse, but they are different. I catch them and eat them. They are good.

Voles. They come out in the dark, and I catch them with a quick dive. They are the most common, and I eat them when they are fresh. I can hear them moving under the leaves, and I strike. Sometimes I miss, but most of the time I get them. I don't like voles, but they are good food.
